The initial map injects (0,z₀); each successor composes the Borel next map with the previous record and the measurable n-th coordinate of the threshold sequence. ten_BODY_and_formula_step_reviews.text: Induct on the index, generalizing the candidate active record. At zero the phase is z₀. A stopped predecessor or infinite clock cannot produce an active successor. A finite active successor is SΦ_q(z); flow preservation and bounce preservation give H(SΦ_q(z))=H(z)=H(z₀).

ten_BODY_and_formula_step_reviews.text: At every successor, stopped records remain stopped and have time ∞. An active record either stops, increasing its extended time to ∞, or adds a nonnegative finite wait. Successor monotonicity gives monotonicity on ℕ. A separate induction on k proves that stopping at n persists at n+k.

T₀=0 also uses the base definition and final assembly L405, so it is not falsely assigned solely to this step slice.

ten_BODY_and_formula_step_reviews.text: For an active phase z, combine its inherited H(z)=H(z₀) with H(Φ_tz)=H(z). The actual rate is nonnegative, and the already proved same-energy-layer bound gives λ(Φ_tz)≤C(z₀). Since C depends on phase only through H, it also gives C(z)=C(z₀).
